outcome: neonatal gut microbiota (diversity, composition, and specific taxa)
cohort: The study included neonates born to mothers with (n=114) and without (n=133) gestational diabetes mellitus, from whom meconium samples were collected.
finding: Newborns from mothers with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) had similar compositions but different abundances of gut microbiota compared to those from normoglycemic mothers, and other perinatal characteristics also influenced the neonatal gut microbiota.
mod_finding: Neonatal delivery mode influenced the differential taxa of the neonatal gut microbiota, showing 226 representative taxa in the control group but none in the GDM group.
